name: Structural Understanding Capabilities (SUC) Benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' understanding of structured table data through seven tasks including cell lookup, row retrieval, and size detection. It assesses the impact of input format and prompting strategies on LLM performance.
reputation: A niche benchmark for structured table understanding that is cited in research on table reasoning, but it is not a mainstream standardized benchmark.
notes: Open-source benchmark with code and data available; proposes self-augmentation prompting methods improving performance on tabular tasks.
